inject.text: Stages must operate on AST nodes ONLY. String ops belong in src/utils/text.ts.
core/ files are WIRING ONLY — no business logic. Must stay zero-dep (no runtime dependencies).
cli/ and mcp/ are thin adapters over core/. No business logic here.
Dependency flow is one-way: types/ → utils/ → stages/ & parser/ → core/ → cli/ & mcp/. Never import from cli/ or mcp/ here.
PITFALL: PostToolUse additionalContext at top level is silently ignored. Wrap in hookSpecificOutput: { hookEventName, additionalContext }.

inject.hint: src/types/ — AST node types used by the parser are defined here

inject.text: Primary invariant: expand(compact(md)) === md for ALL inputs. Prefer approaches that guarantee round-trip over higher compression.
WRONG TOOL: use BUN, not npm/yarn/pnpm. Rewrite the command with bun.
WRONG TOOL: use BIOME for linting/formatting, not eslint/prettier.
Package manager is BUN. Use 'bun add' to install deps. Keep dependencies minimal — core/ must stay zero-dep. Prefer peerDependencies for optional integrations (e.g. tiktoken).
Every MCP tool MUST have a corresponding CLI command in src/cli/commands/. If adding a new MCP tool, also add its CLI counterpart.
Every CLI command MUST have a corresponding MCP tool in src/mcp/tools/. If adding a new CLI command, also add its MCP counterpart.
These tools are intentionally EXCLUDED from MCP registration: ctx_verify, ctx_metrics, ctx_tokens, ctx_locate. Do NOT re-register them without explicit approval.
Only markdown compact/expand is lossless round-trip. Diff compression, log pruning, and code outline are intentionally ONE-WAY and LOSSY. Do not attempt to add expand/round-trip for these formats.

@Skills: Use ctx-search (codebase exploration), ctx-code (changes via read-patch cycle), ctx-verify (review diffs/run tests) instead of raw file reads or manual tool invocations.
Learnings system: if you discover something non-obvious about a file (architecture constraints, pitfalls, patterns), record it with: node .claude/hooks/learn.mjs add --files '<glob>' --learning '<text>'. Only record genuinely useful insights. Use list/update/remove to curate existing learnings.

[Types purity] src/types/ must contain ONLY pure TS declarations: interfaces, type aliases, import type. Zero runtime code — no functions, classes, const values, enums, or non-type imports. Runtime code goes in src/utils/.

[Stage barrel] Each stage barrel (index.ts) MUST export exactly one Stage object via createStage() from '../stage.js'. Sub-stage helpers are internal functions — only the barrel's createStage() export is public.

[Stage pipeline] New stages must use createStage() from src/stages/stage.ts. Barrel index.ts exports the Stage; internal helpers export plain functions. Stages: dedup, whitespace, semantic, elision, extract, aggressive/unwrap.

[MCP registry] Each tool file MUST export exactly one registerXxxTool(server) function (register + PascalCaseName + Tool). New tools must be called from registerCompactMdTools() in index.ts unless intentionally excluded.
